input.body: We are writing to ask for a review of the deduction of $31.20 on order UE-tf06f, dated 2026-11-08. The reason given for the deduction was a missing item, Butter Chicken. Our records also show the order was ready at 18:47 and was picked up at 18:50, 3 minutes later [UE-tf06f:pickup_handoff]. Based on the ticket, Butter Chicken was not part of this order as it was placed with us. We therefore ask that the deduction be reviewed and reversed. Please let us know if any further information would help. Thank you for your time.
